## Retention Schedules  
**See [[policy_retention]] for detailed retention by data type.**  
**Standard Retention Summary:**  
| Data Type | Retention Period | Basis |
|-----------|------------------|-------|
| Customer profile | Account tenure + 6 years | POCA, anti-fraud |
| Transaction records | 6 years minimum | Regulatory, dispute |
| KYC/AML records | 5-6 years post-closure | AML regulations |
| Complaint records | 6 years minimum | Regulatory |
| Marketing consent | Until withdrawal | GDPR consent |
| Website cookies | Session (+ 14 months analytics) | Cookie consent |

raw_entities.name: Data Retention Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing retention periods for customer data, transaction records, KYC/AML documentation, complaints, marketing consent, and website cookies. Establishes minimum retention periods aligned with regulatory obligations under POCA, AML regulations, and GDPR.
context: See [[policy_retention]] for detailed retention by data type.
Standard Retention Summary
Retention Period | Basis

raw_entities.name: Customer Profile Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates retention of customer profile data for the duration of account tenure plus 6 years. Basis includes POCA compliance and anti-fraud obligations.
context: Customer profile | Account tenure + 6 years | POCA, anti-fraud

raw_entities.name: Transaction Records Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requires retention of transaction records for a minimum of 6 years. Basis includes regulatory requirements and dispute resolution obligations.
context: Transaction records | 6 years minimum | Regulatory, dispute

raw_entities.name: KYC/AML Records Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates retention of KYC and AML records for 5-6 years following account closure. Basis is AML regulatory compliance.
context: KYC/AML records | 5-6 years post-closure | AML regulations

raw_entities.name: Complaint Records Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requires retention of complaint records for a minimum of 6 years. Basis is regulatory compliance.
context: Complaint records | 6 years minimum | Regulatory

raw_entities.name: Marketing Consent Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandates retention of marketing consent records until customer withdrawal. Basis is GDPR consent management.
context: Marketing consent | Until withdrawal | GDPR consent

raw_entities.name: Website Cookies Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Requires retention of website cookies for the session duration, plus 14 months for analytics data. Basis is cookie consent compliance.
context: Website cookies | Session (+ 14 months analytics) | Cookie consent

raw_entities.name: Proceeds of Crime Act 2002
raw_entities.description: UK legislation establishing anti-money laundering and asset recovery obligations. Referenced as basis for customer profile retention requirements.
context: Customer profile | Account tenure + 6 years | POCA, anti-fraud

raw_entities.name: AML Regulations
raw_entities.description: Regulatory framework governing anti-money laundering compliance. Referenced as basis for KYC/AML records retention requirements.
context: KYC/AML records | 5-6 years post-closure | AML regulations

raw_entities.name: General Data Protection Regulation
raw_entities.description: EU data protection regulation governing consent management and data retention. Referenced as basis for marketing consent and cookie retention requirements.
context: Marketing consent | Until withdrawal | GDPR consent
Website cookies | Session (+ 14 months analytics) | Cookie consent

raw_entities.name: Money Laundering
raw_entities.description: Financial crime risk addressed through KYC/AML records retention for 5-6 years post-closure, as mandated by AML regulations.
context: KYC/AML records | 5-6 years post-closure | AML regulations

raw_entities.name: Fraud
raw_entities.description: Fraud risk addressed through retention of customer profile data for account tenure plus 6 years, supporting anti-fraud compliance obligations.
context: Customer profile | Account tenure + 6 years | POCA, anti-fraud
